headline: Bitcoin is holding near $80,000 after Saturday's dip below it, as President Trump says a US strike on Iran could come "maybe tomorrow" or a deal could be reached instead.

stories.title: Bitcoin holds near $80,000 as Trump says an Iran strike could come "maybe tomorrow"
stories.summary: Bitcoin slipped below $80,000 on Saturday, its weakest level in more than a month, then climbed back to about $80,200. The drop forced out hundreds of millions of dollars of borrowed-money bets on rising prices. President Trump has since said a US strike on Iran was possible "maybe tomorrow", but so was a deal.
points: Lows differ by venue: about $79,280 on The Block's bitcoin price page around 11:20am ET, and $79,220.74 on Binance's BTC/USDT between 15:00 and 16:00 UTC, per Cointribune, which put bitcoin back near $80,200 afterwards.

Sources differ on the 24-hour total of leveraged positions liquidated (forcibly closed): about $841M, $697M of them bets on rising prices, per CoinGlass data cited by Cointribune; $815.26M per The Block's earlier report.
Trump told reporters after voting in Florida: "Maybe tomorrow... There's a possibility I will. There's also a possibility we'll have a nice, big, beautiful agreement," per The Tribune (ANI).
CoinDesk tied the slide to reports of fast US evacuations from Middle East embassies and bases. Brent crude is about $117, its highest since April, per Al Jazeera.
Arthur Hayes said he closed the directional trading book at his family office Maelstrom, citing macro and geopolitical risk, per The Block.

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs lost money two days running, but the week still ended up
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors, saw money leave on Thursday and Friday. Strong buying earlier in the week means the week as a whole still ended with more money in than out. ETFs do not trade at weekends, so the next figures come after Monday's session.
points: Friday 23 Oct: -$137.94M, led by BlackRock's IBIT (-$110.34M) and Fidelity's FBTC (-$31.78M), per SoSoValue data cited by The Block.
Thursday 22 Oct: -$635.49M, per SoSoValue via The Block.
The week still ended at a net +$304.73M, and total bitcoin ETF assets are $104.43B, per The Block.
Ether ETFs took in $4.35M on Friday but lost $220.60M over the week, per The Block.

stories.title: Two DeFi projects hit in a day: Initia still offline, X100 drained of about $4.7M
stories.summary: Initia, a blockchain network, is still paused after an attacker used a software bug to create unbacked tokens and move about $2.7M out. Separately, attackers took control of the X100 protocol's voting system and drained about $4.7M in stablecoins. Users of affected apps cannot move funds while a network is paused.
points: Initia: the attacker used a bug in its MoveVM software to credit itself with unbacked tokens, then moved out about $2.7M, which was swapped into about 1,135.52 ETH, per PANews.
Initia says a fix should take a few days and must pass an audit, per PANews; it has given no restart date, per Unchained.

X100: attackers used contracts to win a voting majority in the protocol's "Senate", forced its treasury to sell assets into a pool they controlled and took about $4.7M in stablecoins, per Cryptonomist.
The X100 money left as ETH in four wallets of 400 ETH each, per Cryptonomist.

briefs.title: Bitget hacker moves another $19.48M
briefs.summary: Arkham data shows the hacker moved $19.48M, mostly bitcoin, to new addresses from 21 to 24 Oct and still holds about $242.5M, per Cryptonomist.

briefs.title: Franklin Templeton puts $150M more of a tokenized fund on the XRP Ledger
briefs.summary: That takes its sgBENJI money-market fund shares there to about $200M, all in one issuer-controlled wallet, and Franklin has not formally announced it, per 24/7 Wall St.

briefs.title: Tether says 15 mining operators and equipment makers will build on its open-source mining kit
briefs.summary: They include Bitmain, Bitdeer, Canaan and Foundry, with a 1.0 version targeted before the end of 2026, per The Crypto Basic.
